item.title: Palo Alto to explore closing Churchill rail crossing at community’s urging
item.description: In response to a teenager’s death at the Churchill Avenue Caltrain crossing on Feb. 3, Palo Alto leaders are accelerating their efforts reduce access to the train tracks, up to and including closing the crossing altogether. The post Palo Alto to explore closing Churchill rail crossing at community’s urging appeared first on Palo Alto Online.

item.title: Palo Alto tops U.S. cities for highest property tax bills
item.description: In Palo Alto, where the median home price now exceeds $3 million, property taxes have become a major cost of homeownership. The city ranks highest in the nation for median property taxes paid, according to a new analysis by Construction Coverage. The post Palo Alto tops U.S. cities for highest property tax bills appeared first on Palo Alto Online.

item.title: Battery tests sparked two fires at Tesla lab in Palo Alto
item.description: A laboratory in Palo Alto where Tesla Motors was testing lithium-ion batteries was shut down for about three weeks in January after the batteries caused a fire and damaged a water line in the company’s testing chamber, according to Fire Department records obtained by this publication. The post Battery tests sparked two fires at Tesla lab in Palo Alto appeared first on Palo Alto Online.
